verdict.rationale: DeepInfra is an AI inference cloud, and a platform like this could plausibly ship an in-product assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents OpenAI-compatible inference APIs, model hosting and GPU rentals. These are developer building blocks for building an assistant, not a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
